set.body: Acceptance criteria: DType formats logical values for previews, diagnostics, errors, and examples; UInt8 255 and high UInt16 values render as unsigned magnitudes; formatting preserves Boolean, signed integral, floating NaN, infinity, and signed-zero semantics; the unary-plus copy policy is explicitly documented and tested for owned, borrowed, and mutable readable inputs; public behavior agrees on JVM and Scala.js; and focused source/API tests pass without weakening dtype closure or ownership.
set.title: Add dtype-aware formatting and decide unary-plus semantics
